## 2. YouTube description (the first two lines are the hook shown before “more”)

### 2.1 English (main) — 3023 characters (limit 5000)

```text
Three peaks in one unknown sample. Which compound is which?
GC-MS separates them first, then reads their fragments — on a schematic, in under 90 seconds.

In this video:
• The gas chromatograph on a schematic with numbered parts: carrier gas, autosampler, heated injector, an oven with a capillary column, and a heated transfer line.
• Compounds leave the column at different times (retention time); for GC the analyte must be volatile, sometimes after derivatization.
• The mass spectrometer: ion source, quadrupole, detector, vacuum pumps and data system. Molecules are ionised and break into fragment ions; the quadrupole sorts the ions by m/z and passes them in turn.
• The result: a chromatogram over retention time and a mass spectrum for every peak; compounds are identified against a spectral library or standards; without quality control, peaks that don’t belong to the sample can appear.
• Real LabGuide screens: Lab → Instruments and methods → Toxicology → the GC-MS card — the same schematic and parts, then principle and tasks, each with its source; QC notes and biosafety (hot parts, glasses, coat and gloves).

Chapters
0:00 Three peaks and the gas chromatograph
0:17 Retention time, volatility, the mass spectrometer
0:33 Ions and the quadrupole (m/z)
0:43 The result: chromatogram, spectrum, identity, QC
0:58 In LabGuide: the GC-MS card

What LabGuide does today:
• LabGuide has a GC-MS reference card in Lab → Instruments and methods → Toxicology: the schematic with numbered parts, then principle and tasks, each with its source.
• The card also has QC notes and biosafety notes: hot parts, glasses, coat and gloves.
• A reference card: methods and limits come from your laboratory and its SOPs.

Good to know:
• Schematic — not an exact model.
• The chromatogram and spectra are illustrative schematic panels — no real compound, no numbers on the axes.
• The card in the app is itself marked as not yet expert-reviewed, and this video’s content is awaiting expert review.

LabGuide is a clinical-laboratory companion app for lab professionals and students (English, Russian, Uzbek). It is a learning and reference tool: it does not diagnose or interpret patient results. Works offline and without an account.
Get the app: [[LINK_APP_STORE]] · [[LINK_PLAY]]

Illustrative data — not patient results.
Educational use, not medical advice.
English synthetic narration (Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0); English subtitles.
```

### 2.2 Русский — 3059 characters (limit 5000)

```text
Три пика в неизвестной пробе. Какое вещество где?
ГХ-МС сначала разделяет их, потом читает их фрагменты — на схеме, меньше чем за 90 секунд.

В этом видео:
• Газовый хроматограф на схеме с пронумерованными частями: газ-носитель, автосэмплер, нагреваемый инжектор, термостат с капиллярной колонкой и нагреваемая линия переноса.
• Вещества выходят из колонки в разное время (время удерживания); для ГХ аналит должен быть летучим, иногда после дериватизации.
• Масс-спектрометр: источник ионов, квадруполь, детектор, вакуумные насосы и система данных. Молекулы ионизируются и распадаются на ионы-фрагменты; квадруполь разделяет ионы по m/z и пропускает их по очереди.
• Итог: хроматограмма по времени удерживания и масс-спектр каждого пика; вещество находят по библиотеке спектров или стандартам; без контроля качества в спектре могут появиться чужие пики.
• Реальные экраны LabGuide: Лаб. → Приборы и методики → Токсикология → карточка ГХ-МС — та же схема и детали, затем принцип и задачи, у каждого источник; контроль качества и биобезопасность (горячие части, очки, халат, перчатки).
```

* Music: none. Logo: owner's app icon (`assets/images/logo_mark_large.png`).

## 10. End screen / CTA suggestion

* YouTube end screen (last ~7–20 s): subscribe + the next video in the SAME language edition (`qpcr`, `photometry`) + the playlist `[[LINK_PLAYLIST]]`. Place elements so they do not cover the end card's path pill or disclosure notices (check against the final scene).
* Description and pinned comment carry the store links (`[[LINK_APP_STORE]]`, `[[LINK_PLAY]]`); the video itself shows only the in-app path, no URL and no price.
* Instagram: link in bio (`[[LINK_BIO]]`); ask viewers to save/share, not to "download now".

## 11. Safe-content notes

* No patient data, names or real results anywhere. All numbers on screen are illustrative and labelled so.
* No third-party logo, brand name, stock footage or music. The only logo is the owner's app icon.
* Do not call the voice "natural", "professional" or "human": it is synthetic and nobody has listened to it yet.
* Do not call the content "approved", "verified", "certified" or "clinically validated": expert review is pending.
* No diagnosis, treatment, dosing or "normal range" statement. Reference ranges come from the user's laboratory.
* Do not answer individual medical questions in comments; point to the user's laboratory SOP, the reagent IFU and the clinician.
* No price, discount, product id or availability date in any text (docs/DECISIONS.md D-77/D-78: prices live in the stores).
* Check the platform's own disclosure setting for AI-generated / synthetic voice before posting (NEEDS_OWNER_CHECK: the rules change; the kit already states the voice is synthetic in the text).
* Audience: not made for kids. Category: Education. Comments: moderate; hide spam and requests for medical advice.
